Seniors (age 9-13)
Welcome to the Senior Department at Ashfold, where Forms 5 - 8 are designed to nurture independent learning and academic excellence.
At this stage, our pupils take greater ownership of their learning, transitioning from the supportive environment of the Junior years to a more academically focused setting. Yet it is the breadth of opportunities available at Ashfold that truly enables our children to develop their knowledge and skills, achieving success to the best of their ability.
We diligently prepare our pupils for their chosen Senior School entrance and Scholarship examinations and take immense pride in our outstanding academic record. Each year, around half of our Form 6 pupils undertake a wide range of Scholarship examinations for some of the country’s most prestigious schools, while some also sit the 11+ examinations for entry into Buckinghamshire grammar schools.
Our lessons are designed to be both challenging and enjoyable, ensuring that children are actively engaged in their learning. Beyond the classroom, we place great emphasis on developing individual talents and building confidence through a variety of co-curricular activities. Regular assemblies, music and drama productions, and a diverse range of sporting activities all contribute to a well-rounded education.
Our Senior Department provides our pupils with the knowledge, skills, and solid foundation necessary for future learning. We are proud to see our students leave us as confident, articulate, and well-rounded young people, ready to thrive in their next academic endeavours.
Elisa Woodford Director of Studies
"Pupils achieve high standards both in their academic studies and in the extensive range of extra-curricular pursuits"
- ISI Inspection Report

pageCache.text:
Nursery Curriculum
Our experienced team of teachers ensures that every child settles in quickly and feels secure, enabling them to take their first confident steps in learning. The curriculum is based on the Early Years Foundation Stage (EYFS) framework, providing a balanced mix of adult-led and child-initiated activities.
Guided by the EYFS framework, we focus on the following key developmental areas for these early years:
Communication and Language: Through storytelling, songs, and interactive conversations, children begin to develop essential language skills. They learn to express their thoughts, engage in dialogue, and build the vocabulary that will serve as the foundation for all future learning.
Personal, Social and Emotional Development: In our nurturing environment, children learn to understand their own feelings and those of others. They build confidence, develop positive relationships, and learn important social skills such as sharing, taking turns, and cooperating with peers.
Physical Development: With plenty of opportunities for active play both indoors and outdoors, children enhance their fine and gross motor skills. From climbing and running to manipulating small objects during creative play, they develop coordination and a love for physical activity.
Literacy: Early exposure to letters, sounds, and stories develops a love for reading and writing. Through engaging activities, children begin to recognise letters and words, laying the groundwork for future literacy skills.
Mathematics: Through playful, hands-on activities, children are introduced to basic mathematical concepts such as numbers, shapes, and patterns. This playful exploration makes learning maths fun and accessible.
Understanding the World: By engaging in nature walks, simple experiments, and interactive experiences in our Forest School, children explore their surroundings and develop an early awareness of the world. They learn about different environments, communities, and the wonders of nature.
Expressive Arts and Design: Creative expression is at the heart of our curriculum. Whether through drawing, painting, music, or imaginative play, children are encouraged to express themselves artistically, nurturing their individuality and creativity.
Nursery is not just about learning; it’s about creating a sense of belonging in a warm, family-like setting. We develop each child’s unique potential, ensuring that their first steps into education are filled with curiosity, confidence, and joy. We make full use of the School’s beautiful grounds for outdoor learning and physical exercise and share its extensive facilities including the Saloon, the Library, the Sports Hall and the Performance Studio.
"The contribution of teaching is excellent in the EYFS"
- ISI Inspection Report

Reception Curriculum
Our Reception curriculum is designed to inspire young learners in an environment where play-based learning meets structured teaching. In our two dedicated classes, the classrooms open onto an enclosed outdoor area and playground, allowing for a seamless blend of indoor exploration and outdoor adventure. Each room is equipped with dedicated areas for both learning and discovery.
We combine the benefits of a play-based approach with more formal learning, ensuring that every child develops essential skills while enjoying the process of exploration. Specialist teaching in Music enriches the curriculum, and regular trips to local places of interest—as well as visits from engaging speakers—further enhance the learning experience, bringing real-world connections into the classroom.
Our children also make full use of the School’s beautiful grounds for outdoor learning and physical exercise. They benefit from access to extensive facilities including the Art & Design Centre, the Saloon, the Library, the Sports Hall, and the Performance Studio.
Building on the foundations laid in Nursery, our Reception curriculum deepens children’s learning. It continues to align with the EYFS framework by focusing on:
''In the EYFS, children thoroughly enjoy their learning and achieve extremely well''
- ISI Inspection Report

Pre-Prep 2 Curriculum
Pre-Prep 2 is a vital transition phase at Ashfold, where we prepare our young learners for the more structured environment of the Juniors. During this stage, we continue to introduce a more formal style of learning through a subject-based curriculum that includes:
In addition to our broad curriculum, specialist teaching and support are provided from the Prep School in key areas such as Music, Art, Computing, and PE & Games. This enriched learning experience ensures that every child receives tailored guidance as they develop new skills and prepare for the next stage in the Prep School.
Our children continue to benefit from regular trips and engaging visits from inspiring speakers. They also start to take part in whole-school events, mixing with older pupils, which further enhances their learning experience and fosters a strong sense of community.
The focus of Pre-Prep 2 is on three core areas:
Academic Readiness: We consolidate literacy and numeracy skills while introducing routines that ease the transition to formal schooling, ensuring a solid academic foundation.
Emotional and Social Skills: Emphasising decision-making, problem-solving, and resilience, we nurture both academic and emotional preparedness. This stage builds confidence and helps children develop the interpersonal skills necessary for success in a more structured school setting.
Personal Development: Our balanced curriculum integrates physical activity, creative exploration, and academic tasks. This approach nurtures every aspect of a child’s growth, ensuring they leave Pre-Prep with strong academic foundations and the confidence and independence needed for the Juniors.

Pre-Prep (age 4-7)
Welcome to our Pre-Prep - this is where the magic happens!
I am delighted to welcome you into our warm, family-like setting, where every day is a new adventure in learning and discovery. At Ashfold, we believe that every child is unique and deserves a supportive, inspiring environment where they can explore, learn, and grow at their own pace.
Our aim is simple: to give every child the best possible start to their education. We lay strong foundations in essential skills while nurturing enthusiasm, curiosity, and confidence that will serve them well in the years ahead. During their time in Pre-Prep, our young children grow and develop at an astonishing rate, and it is our privilege to witness their progress and support them on this exciting journey.
Courage, kindness, and respect underpin our daily life here, creating an atmosphere where healthy bodies and minds are nurtured. We encourage our children to learn from trial and error, to explore with curiosity, and to embrace challenges as opportunities for growth.
Our passionate Pre-Prep staff are dedicated to creating a rich and varied learning experience for every child. By blending engaging, active learning with innovative ideas, our classrooms, meadows, and play areas are always buzzing with purposeful play, lively activity, and the joyful chatter of children. This inclusive approach ensures that each child can develop their individual talents and unique personality.
I warmly invite you to visit us and experience some of this magic for yourself and your child.
Louise White Head of Pre-Prep Department
"Staff build warm, trusting relationships with the children, ensuring that their needs are met and that they feel safe, happy and confident to try new experiences"
- ISI Inspection Report

Each year we prepare our girls and boys for a wide range of scholarships to some of the best schools in the country.
For pupils applying for scholarships, we offer a well-developed scholarship programme that provides targeted support in academics, sport, music, art, drama, and other specialist areas. Over recent years, an impressive 45% of our Form 8 leavers have won scholarships or awards to their senior schools—a testament to the dedication and excellence of our pupils and staff.
We are tremendously proud of our children's achievements and the well-rounded education that prepares them for the next stage of their education.

English and Languages
We believe that language unlocks opportunity, helping pupils express themselves with confidence, connect with others and explore different cultures and ideas. Whether developing their creativity through English, learning to communicate in a new language, or unpicking the stories behind ancient words, our pupils are encouraged to see language not just as a subject, but as a key to understanding the world.
Through stimulating lessons, creative writing, debate, performance and immersive cultural experiences, we nurture both fluency and curiosity, helping every pupil find their voice and develop a lifelong appreciation for the richness and power of language.
Our aim is to ensure pupils leave Ashfold not only with strong linguistic skills, but also with the confidence to express themselves clearly, the cultural awareness to thrive in an international world, and a love of language that will stay with them for life.
English
English inspires a love of language and literature, helping pupils develop the skills to read critically, write creatively and express themselves with confidence. From storytelling and poetry to debate and drama, pupils are encouraged to explore their ideas, sharpen their thinking and find their unique voice.
French
French opens a door to the wider world, with a focus on practical communication, cultural understanding and linguistic confidence. Through games, conversation practice, creative projects and trips, pupils develop fluency and enthusiasm, while discovering the richness of French culture. French lessons start in Reception.
Classics (Latin)
Latin gives pupils a window into the ancient world, exploring the language, myths and history of Rome while laying the foundations for modern languages. Pupils develop linguistic precision, analytical thinking and a deeper understanding of how Latin shaped English and many other languages.
Spanish
Spanish introduces pupils to one of the world’s most widely spoken languages, helping them develop confidence and curiosity through lively conversation practice, cultural exploration and practical language skills. Pupils gain both linguistic fluency and a deeper appreciation of the Spanish-speaking world.
Mandarin
Mandarin gives pupils an exciting introduction to a global language of the future, helping them develop practical communication skills alongside a fascination for Chinese culture. Through games, creative projects and immersive language experiences, pupils build confidence and curiosity, laying the foundations for future study.

pageCache.pageTitle: Headmaster's Welcome - Ashfold Private Independent School
pageCache.text:
Head's Welcome
It is my great privilege and honour to be the Head of Ashfold and a pleasure to welcome you to our wonderful school.
The values and traditions of a country prep school remain as strong today as ever, placing Ashfold among the leading schools in the area. We provide an environment where children can truly be children—immersing themselves in the great outdoors while developing the character needed to thrive in an ever-changing world.
Set amidst 35 acres of glorious grounds, Ashfold is home to exceptional facilities, including state-of-the-art teaching spaces, a dedicated sports hall, games pitches, an outdoor swimming pool, modern art and design technology studios, and our stunning Jacobean mansion. As a day and boarding school, we embrace a strong family ethos where every child feels valued and supported.
As a parent of young children myself, I fully appreciate the trust you place in us when you choose Ashfold for your child’s education. We take this responsibility seriously, offering outstanding pastoral care that is proactive rather than reactive. Every member of staff, regardless of their role, plays a part in ensuring our pupils feel safe, happy, and nurtured in all they do.
We take great pride in our commitment to all-round excellence. Our pupils achieve scholarships across a variety of disciplines to some of the country’s top senior schools. However, education at Ashfold extends far beyond academic achievement. We believe in providing rich opportunities and experiences that allow every child to discover their own unique talents and passions, nurturing them into independent, curious, and well-rounded learners.
Every child has immeasurable potential, and at Ashfold, we are committed to nurturing and developing it. To thrive in an ever-changing world, young people must be curious, resilient, courageous, and ambitious change-makers. Through a rich and varied education, we equip our pupils with the knowledge, skills, and values to embrace challenges with confidence, preparing them not just for senior school but for life beyond.
Our goal is to ensure that every child leaves Ashfold with the social, emotional, and academic foundations they need to flourish. We want them to step forward as kind, ambitious, and self-assured individuals, ready to make a meaningful impact in a supportive and inspiring environment.
I would be delighted to welcome you to Ashfold in person, to show you around our school and, most importantly, to introduce you to our wonderful pupils. We are incredibly proud of the warm and special atmosphere we have created here, and I hope you will come and experience it for yourself.
An inspiring and nurturing
environment which puts children first
- Good Schools Guide
